logp.method_description: The shake flask procedure outlined previously 28, 46 was followed for the determination of solubility and log P values. A saturated solution of complex was suspended in H2O (pre-saturated with n-octanol) and shaken for 4 days on an orbital shaker. The solution was centrifuged for 5 min at 2000 rpm prior to aqueous aliquots being collected for total Ru concentration analysis, and partition experiments with n-octanol (pre-saturated with H2O) at three ratios (2:1, 1:1, and 0.5:1). After 30 min incubation time on an orbital shaker, the samples were shaken by hand for an additional 5 min and were then centrifuged at 10 000 rpm for 5 min. The aqueous layer was collected with a syringe and diluted 1:100 in 5% HNO3. The ruthenium content was measured via direct infusion through an ASX-500 autosampler (CETAC technologies) in a Serie SuSi laminar flow hood (SPECTEC) into an Agilent 7700 ICP-MS, equipped with a MicroMist nebulizer and a Scott double pass spray chamber. All analysis were carried out in triplicate unless otherwise specified.
